sourceSnapshot.hashPolicy: Informational only. Exact per-field before/after and model identity guards permit unrelated integration changes.

scope.qualification: Implements explicit spot-check findings plus the same BasiX source-note and Gamma FAQ echoes. Not a fresh full-80 review or a broad copy rewrite.

preservation: Every numeric token in each edited before/after field is identical and in the same order.
Only the listed public string leaves change; all IDs, roles, ratings, defaults, exclusions, package data, metadata and source links remain unchanged.

Historical/region scope, no-stock/no-hands-on qualifications, image captions and nominal-versus-actual-break warnings remain unchanged unless explicitly restated with the same meaning in a listed leaf.
Original packs, non-rendered fallback copies, shared scripts, CSV imports, release files and hosted/native pages are outside this overlay application.

changes.before: The verified 10 lb X4 is .007 inch / .17 mm. The old catalog entry of .006 inch must not be reused for this model merely because it matches a different J-Braid.
changes.after: For a 10 lb X4 fill, use its listed .007 inch / .17 mm diameter when estimating reel capacity. A .006 inch figure from a different J-Braid model is not interchangeable.
changes.reason: Make the opening useful for capacity planning without recommending a fishing strength; preserve all listed values and model distinction.

changes.before: Use 200 yards for the verified 4, 8, 10, 12, and 15 lb SKUs, and 175 yards for 20 lb. The source also generates empty-SKU combinations; those are not offered here.
changes.after: The verified packages are 200 yards for 4, 8, 10, 12, and 15 lb, and 175 yards for 20 lb. Other strength-and-length combinations are not included in this guide.
changes.reason: State exact supported packages without describing the source system; the separate six-pound exclusion is unchanged.

changes.before: The menu has combinations, but exact assigned SKUs only substantiate 200 yards through 15 lb and 175 yards at 20 lb. Empty-SKU combinations are excluded.
changes.after: For the strengths included in this guide, verified packages are 200 yards through 15 lb and 175 yards at 20 lb. Other strength-and-length combinations have not been verified here.
changes.reason: Describe the verified range without claiming every possible package is unavailable or restoring the excluded six-pound strength.

changes.before: Checked 2026-09-13 against Seaguar's product and public variant response. Empty-SKU combinations excluded. Six-pound discrepancy documented; no silent diameter conversion overrides it.
changes.after: Checked 2026-09-13 against Seaguar's product page and listed package options. Only verified strength-and-length combinations are included. The six-pound diameter discrepancy remains unresolved; no converted value replaces either published figure.
changes.reason: Remove the same empty-SKU wording in the source note while preserving the review date, verified-package limitation and unresolved diameter pair.

changes.before: Checked 2026-09-13. Australian and European tables reviewed independently. This is not a cross-region diameter join; only the complete Australian bulk rows are candidates.
changes.after: Checked 2026-09-13. Australian and European tables were reviewed separately. This chart covers only the complete Australian bulk specifications; European specifications and shorter filler-package diameters are not substituted.
changes.reason: Replace join/candidate language with the same regional and complete-bulk-only scope. Existing 3,000-meter identification remains unchanged elsewhere.

changes.before: The official chart lists 16 lb instead. The old 15 lb record is held, and the verified 16 lb row receives its own ID.
changes.after: The official chart lists 16 lb instead. It does not verify a 15 lb option; the 16 lb specification must not be relabelled.
changes.reason: Explain the source-backed strength identity, not the database ID operation. Other exclusions and stock limitations remain unchanged.

changes.before: The next steps include 12 and 16 lb. No matching 15 lb U.S.-size leader appears in the reviewed current tables, so that legacy ID is excluded rather than renamed.
changes.after: The next steps include 12 and 16 lb. The reviewed current tables do not list a 15 lb U.S.-size leader; a nearby strength is not an interchangeable label.
changes.reason: Keep the reviewed-table and nominal U.S.-size limitations without legacy-ID instructions.

changes.before: Choose it for the terminal section between the actual main line and the lure, bait or fly. Decide on leader diameter, connection and finished length for the presentation and cover; the main line determines spool capacity. The official range uses 16 lb, not the 15 lb legacy label.
changes.after: Choose it for the terminal section between the actual main line and the lure, bait or fly. Decide on leader diameter, connection and finished length for the presentation and cover; the main line determines spool capacity. The official range lists 16 lb, not 15 lb.
changes.reason: Remove legacy-label wording only; retain terminal use and mainline/leader distinction.

changes.before: The reviewed official U.S.-size table uses 16 lb, not 15 lb. The legacy 15 lb ID remains held rather than being relabeled.
changes.after: The reviewed official U.S.-size table uses 16 lb, not 15 lb. A 15 lb option is not verified by that table and is not included in this guide.
changes.reason: Remove the repeated legacy-ID explanation in the same model case; do not broaden the claim beyond the reviewed U.S. table.
